item.title: Sharper pleads guilty to fraud charges
item.description: Former state Rep. Dexter Sharper, a Valdosta Democrat, pleaded guilty to federal fraud charges in court Wednesday as part of a U.S. Department of Justice investigation into pandemic-related fraud.

item.description: Forget paper money. Georgia senators want to legalize using gold and silver for everyday purchases.

item.title: Hurricane Helene relief program launches for Georgia farmers
